items.author: Musk
items.text: After $86 billion IPO, SpaceX to borrow $20 billion
items.summary_cn: SpaceX在860亿美元IPO后将举债200亿美元，对二级市场/SPCH间接影响取决于融资结构与估值稀释信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Stock Selloff Costs Elon Musk His $1 Trillion Net Worth
items.summary_cn: SpaceX股票抛售导致马斯克万亿净资产失守，对SPCH(2x做多SpaceX ETF)情绪与定价直接构成压力。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk loses trillionaire status as SpaceX and Tesla stock drops
items.summary_cn: 马斯克因SpaceX与Tesla股价下跌而失去万亿富豪头衔，间接利空其旗下资产估值情绪，kcn通过SPCH持有SpaceX敞口。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Just Lost His Trillionaire Status
items.summary_cn: 马斯克因SpaceX与Tesla股价回落而失去万亿富豪头衔，SPCH(2x做多SpaceX)直接受SpaceX估值回撤拖累。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk was the world’s first trillionaire for 12 days
items.summary_cn: 马斯克曾连续12天蝉联全球首位万亿富豪(因SpaceX/Tesla估值飙升)，对SPCH情绪偏正面。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The big Oil Companies are not dropping their price at the pump commensurate with the sharply lower prices they are paying for Oil. Those prices are dropping like a rock! In other words, customers are being “gouged.” I have instructed the DOJ to immediately start looking into this. Gasoline prices better start going down a lot faster than what I’m seeing! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump指责大型石油公司未随原油价格下跌同步下调零售油价为'宰客'，已指示司法部启动调查，油气板块承压。

items.author: Trump
items.text: 19 Millions Barrels of Oil flowed out of the Hormuz Strait yesterday, an all time RECORD. Oil prices are tumbling down, and the World is a much safer place!!! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk denies Tesla’s Autopilot caused crash that killed grandmother
items.summary_cn: 马斯克否认Tesla的Autopilot导致一起致祖孙死亡的撞车事故，监管/诉讼风险延续。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk on fatal Tesla crash in Texas: ‘This makes no sense’
items.summary_cn: 马斯克就德州一起致命Tesla碰撞事故表示'毫无道理'，Autopilot安全问题再度成为舆论焦点。
